$comment: What a role hands back to the coordinator, on the m2-split branch (Part 3; Lecture 6, slide 13). Validated on every return by agent/split/contract.py, and recorded in the trace. `searched` and `spent` are taken from the role's own trace lines, never from what its model says.

role.description: The role, by its tool surface.

run_key.description: The role's own run key: its tool and model calls carry it in the trace.

parent.description: The coordinator's run key: who waits on this return.

task.description: What the coordinator asked of the role, in our code's words.

status.description: found: the result is complete and read from tool results. candidate: a result, with something not determined. out_of_budget: the shared budget ran out first.

result.description: What the role did or found, built by our code from its tool results.

searched.description: Every tool call the role made, in order: the tool and its arguments.

not_searched.description: What the role was asked about but did not look at.

not_determined.description: What the role could not settle, each in one line.
